traits.bark_colour.note: The bark colour chosen by eye for appearance (see its note), as a screen colour: it stood as appearance.bark [0.4, 0.36, 0.3], which is linear light, so the trunk drew pale grey to white beside photographs of the species (2026-10-23). It stands here in sRGB, as bark colours are picked, and the bark rule (tracheophyta) turns it into linear light.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's basin big sagebrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-16): "normally grows 3 to 10 feet (1-2 m) in height"; it "can be treelike in appearance, reaching a height of 16 feet (5 m)".

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS's basin big sagebrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-16): "an erect, rounded or somewhat spreading evergreen shrub".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high), the name's three-toothed wedge-shaped leaf; no source read describes it.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high), the leaf's three teeth at its tip, which no source read describes.

traits.inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: FEIS's basin big sagebrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-16): "Basin big sagebrush flowers from late August to October".

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS (Tirmenstein 1999) gives seed dispersal of about 8 weeks after flowering but no months.

generator.params.note: Rubber rabbitbrush's values, changed by hand for big sagebrush: a rounded, multistemmed shrub with "a relatively thick trunk and an irregular crown" (FEIS, Tirmenstein 1999), wedge-shaped three-toothed silver-grey leaves and narrow panicles of small heads. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.3 m at 12 years in the open, within FEIS's 1-2 m (Tirmenstein 1999). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye: silver-grey foliage; grey shredding bark; dull yellow heads.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922600), as no source read gives it.

traits.life_span.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922600), as no source read gives it.

traits.woodiness.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922600), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922600), as no source read gives it.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922600), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922600), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_apex.note: FNA, Artemisia tridentata (read 2026-10-18): the wedge-shaped leaf has three lobes at its tip, each rounded.
